review.why: Set and review type: scale, line-height, measure, wrapping, tabular numbers, truncation, font loading and punctuation, with Tailwind forms for each rule.
review.summary: Separates measured rules (unitless line-height, weight 400 or more below 18px, 60-75 character measure, 16px inputs on iOS, tabular-nums) from heuristics such as tracking and pairing. Covers role-based scale, heading hierarchy, text-wrap, font features, truncation, bidi, text-box trim and selection, plus a fix table and a CSS cheat sheet.
strengths: Clear split between findings and preferences, and it never proposes a new typeface unless asked.
Specific modern CSS: text-wrap balance and pretty, font-variant-numeric, text-box trim, underline-from-font.
Fix table maps each bad pattern to its replacement, with two options for the iOS input zoom.
cautions: Browser support for newer features such as text-box trim is noted as progressive enhancement; check targets.
Rendering checks (wrapping, last-line words, truncation) need real content in a browser.
SKILL.md read in full, the reference files by headings; not run here.
